title: Applying Headlines
slide_intent: Adapt a headline to the available shape because the message must remain prominent without wasting the format.
strategic_value: Shared edge alignment and format-specific sizing can keep Burger King headlines recognizable across banners and posters.
demonstration: Three grid examples show a single-line banner, a headline within proportional columns and a vertical format with its longest line spanning the margins.
practical_value: Choose the sizing method by aspect ratio and align cap height, allowing ascenders to extend above the top margin.

content_islands.name: Placement guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation and cap-height note at upper left.

content_islands.name: Format examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange numbered banner and column-based layouts at center and a vertical layout at right.

content_islands.name: Three use cases
content_islands.spec: Keep the numbered descriptions beneath the left-hand guidance.

ingredient.name: Headline placement
ingredient.role: Make the primary message fill the format appropriately.
ingredient.application: Fit wide-banner headlines to the available height; use proportional columns if a full-width headline would be too tall; let a vertical format’s longest line span the margins. Align cap height to the top margin.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Ascenders may extend above the top margin.

reference_purposes.Application: The diagrams show vertical fitting for banners, proportional columns where needed and margin-to-margin longest lines for vertical formats.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The cap height touches the top margin; ascenders may protrude above it.
